# Rōmy

> Rōmy is the donor intelligence platform built for small nonprofit fundraising teams who can't afford enterprise prospect research tools.

## What Rōmy Does

Rōmy uses AI-powered prospect research to help small nonprofits find, prioritize, and cultivate major donors. It surfaces wealth indicators, charitable giving histories, career affiliations, and affinity signals — then distills everything into an actionable donor profile your team can actually use.

Unlike enterprise platforms that cost $15,000–$50,000 per year (DonorSearch, iWave, WealthEngine, Blackbaud Target Analytics), Rōmy starts at $0.10 per prospect — built from the ground up for development teams of one or two.

## Who Rōmy Is For

- Small nonprofits (operating budgets under $5M) with 1–3 person development teams
- Frontline fundraisers who do their own prospect research without a dedicated researcher
- Organizations currently using manual research, LinkedIn, or free Google searches for major gift prospecting
- Nonprofits priced out of enterprise wealth screening platforms

## Core Features

**Donor Discovery**: AI-powered prospect research that finds new major donor candidates your team hasn't identified yet.

**Wealth Indicator Screening**: Real estate holdings, business ownership, stock positions, board affiliations, and other capacity signals — synthesized into a readable capacity estimate.

**Giving History Analysis**: Charitable giving records across foundations, public filings, and disclosed donations. Understand a donor's philanthropic priorities and typical gift size.

**Affinity Signal Detection**: Shared interests, institutional ties, geographic connections, and relationship bridges between your organization and a prospect.

**Actionable Profiles**: Every prospect comes with connection points, a suggested giving range, and outreach angles — not just raw data. Your team knows what to say.

**No Enterprise Contracts**: No per-seat licensing, no annual minimums, no procurement process. Built for the budget realities of small nonprofits.

## How Rōmy Compares to Alternatives

| | Rōmy | DonorSearch | iWave | WealthEngine |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Annual Cost | From $0.10/prospect | ~$3,500–$15,000/yr | ~$5,000–$20,000/yr | ~$10,000–$50,000/yr |
| Setup Time | Minutes | Weeks | Weeks | Weeks |
| Target User | Small nonprofits | Mid-to-large | Mid-to-large | Enterprise |
| AI-Native | Yes | No | Partial | No |
| Actionable Output | Yes | Raw data | Raw data | Raw data |

## Benchmark Performance (PIF-Bench)

Rōmy was benchmarked head-to-head against Claude, ChatGPT, and Gemini on the PIF-Bench (Prospect Intelligence Fidelity Benchmark) — a ground-truth test for AI donor research accuracy.

Results:
- Rōmy: 94.6 / 100
- Claude: 92.2 / 100
- ChatGPT: 79.9 / 100
- Gemini: 76.0 / 100

Rōmy outperformed general-purpose AI tools on accuracy, recall, actionability, and source quality because it is purpose-built for donor research — not a general-purpose AI used for donor research.

Full methodology and results: https://getromy.app/labs/blog/benchmarking-ai-prospect-research

## Technical Architecture

Rōmy is an AI-native application built on:
- Purpose-trained models optimized for donor research tasks
- Proprietary data aggregation across public records, philanthropy databases, and professional networks
- Structured output format designed for frontline fundraisers, not data analysts
- Desktop-first architecture for secure, offline-capable prospect management

## Company

GetRomy LLC builds donor intelligence tools for the small nonprofit sector. The company believes that quality prospect research should not require a five-figure enterprise contract — and that AI makes it possible to deliver institutional-quality intelligence at a price any nonprofit can afford.
